title: Participation of Smart Agriculture UGM Researchers at the International ISMAB 2024 Seminar
excerpt: Bali, September 27, 2024 – The 11th International Symposium on Machinery and Mechatronics for Agricultural and Biological Systems Engineering (ISMAB 2024) is a biennial international seminar organized by JSAM (Japanese Society of Agricultural Machinery and Food Engineers), KSAM (Korean Society for Agricultural Machinery), and…
body:
**Bali, September 27, 2024** – The 11th International Symposium on Machinery and Mechatronics for Agricultural and Biological Systems Engineering (ISMAB 2024) is a biennial international seminar organized by JSAM (Japanese Society of Agricultural Machinery and Food Engineers), KSAM (Korean Society for Agricultural Machinery), and CIAM (Chinese Institute of Agricultural Machinery, Taiwan), with full support from ISAE (Indonesian Society of Agricultural Engineering) as a member of ACABE (ASEAN Consortium on Agricultural and Biosystem Engineering). This year, the event was held in Indonesia, specifically at The Patra Bali Resort & Villas on September 27–29, 2024.

The seminar was attended by approximately 365 participants from Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, China, and Indonesia, with a total of 291 symposium participants, including 173 oral presentations and 78 poster presentations. The meeting highlighted the importance of collaboration and knowledge exchange in the field of agricultural engineering, particularly in developing countries where agricultural productivity is vital for economic growth and food security.

**Smart Agriculture Research Center, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Gadjah Mada University (UGM)**, participated actively in ISMAB by submitting two research papers. The topics presented covered various aspects of agricultural technology and its impact on sustainability, emphasizing the need for sustainable practices in agriculture to modernize irrigation. The paper titles are as follows:

1. _Development of a fuzzy logic-based automatic irrigation system utilizing hybrid moisture and environmental sensors for open field horticulture farming_ Researchers: Andri Prima Nugroho, Astriati Hamidah, Lilik Sutiarso, Sigit Supadmo Arif, Takashi Okayasu
2. _Design of a control system for physical model automatic gate controllers in open channel surface irrigation_ Researchers: Ardan Wiratmoko, Andri Prima Nugroho, Murtiningrum, Muhammad Farhan Hidayat, Rio Hatta Prayogi, Lilik Sutiarso, Sigit Supadmo Arif, Takashi Okayasu

The ISMAB symposium serves as a platform for benchmarking, networking, and sharing the latest research findings. Participants engaged in discussions about innovative agricultural technology, sustainable practices, and strategies to increase agricultural productivity while minimizing environmental impact. The exchange of ideas and experiences among researchers from various countries is essential for fostering collaboration and advancing the field of agricultural engineering.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/176-1-smartagri-ismab-2024-2-1024x1007.webp)

Opportunity to meet with Prof. Byoung Kwan Cho – Chungnam National University

In the context of sustainability, the symposium emphasized the role of agriculture in supporting sustainable practices. Researchers presented studies on sustainable agricultural practices, precision agriculture, and the use of renewable energy in agricultural operations. These discussions were highly relevant to developing countries, where the agricultural sector is often vulnerable to climate variability and extreme weather events.

As the symposium concluded, participants expressed their commitment to continuing collaboration and knowledge sharing to address challenges facing the agricultural sector in developing countries. The success of ISMAB 2024 not only highlighted the achievements of Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM but also reinforced the importance of international cooperation in advancing agricultural productivity and sustainability.

original.body:
**Bali, 27 September 2024** – The 11th International Symposium on Machinery and Mechatronics for Agricultural and Biological Systems Engineering (ISMAB 2024) adalah seminar internasional dua tahunan yang diselenggarakan oleh JSAM (Japanese Society of Agricultural Machinery and Food Engineers), KSAM (Korean Society for Agricultural Machinery), dan CIAM (Chinese Institute of Agricultural Machinery, Taiwan), dengan dukungan penuh dari ISAE (Indonesian Society of Agricultural Engineering) sebagai anggota ACABE (ASEAN Consortium on Agricultural and Biosystem Engineering). Tahun ini, acara ini diadakan di Indonesia, tepatnya di The Patra Bali Resort & Villas pada 27 – 29 September 2024.

Seminar ini dihadiri oleh sekitar 365 peserta dari Jepang, Korea Selatan, Taiwan, China, dan Indonesia, dengan total 291 peserta symposium, termasuk 173 presentasi oral dan 78 presentasi poster. Pertemuan ini menyoroti pentingnya kolaborasi dan pertukaran pengetahuan di bidang teknik pertanian, terutama di negara-negara berkembang di mana produktivitas pertanian sangat penting untuk pertumbuhan ekonomi dan ketahanan pangan.

**Smart Agriculture Research Center, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM)**, berpartisipasi aktif dalam ISMAB dengan mengirimkan dua makalah penelitian. Topik yang dipresentasikan mencakup berbagai aspek teknologi pertanian dan dampaknya terhadap keberlanjutan, menekankan perlunya praktik berkelanjutan dalam pertanian untuk memodernisasi irigasi. Judul makalahnya adalah sebagai berikut:

1.  _Development of a fuzzy logic-based automatic irrigation system utilizing hybrid moisture and environmental sensors for open field horticulture farming_ Peneliti: Andri Prima Nugroho, Astriati Hamidah, Lilik Sutiarso, Sigit Supadmo Arif, Takashi Okayasu
2.  _Design of a control system for physical model automatic gate controllers in open channel surface irrigation_ Peneliti: Ardan Wiratmoko, Andri Prima Nugroho, Murtiningrum, Muhammad Farhan Hidayat, Rio Hatta Prayogi, Lilik Sutiarso, Sigit Supadmo Arif, Takashi Okayasu

Simposium ISMAB berfungsi sebagai platform untuk benchmarking, networking, dan berbagi temuan penelitian terbaru. Para peserta terlibat dalam diskusi tentang teknologi pertanian inovatif, praktik berkelanjutan, dan strategi untuk meningkatkan produktivitas pertanian sambil meminimalkan dampak lingkungan. Pertukaran ide dan pengalaman di antara para peneliti dari berbagai negara sangat penting untuk mendorong kolaborasi dan memajukan bidang teknik pertanian.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/176-1-smartagri-ismab-2024-2-1024x1007.webp)

Kesempatan bertemu dengan Prof. Byoung Kwan Cho – Chungnam National University

Dalam konteks keberlanjutan, simposium ini menekankan peran pertanian dalam mendukung praktik berkelanjutan. Para peneliti mempresentasikan studi tentang praktik pertanian berkelanjutan, pertanian presisi, dan penggunaan energi terbarukan dalam operasi pertanian. Diskusi ini sangat relevan bagi negara-negara berkembang, di mana sektor pertanian sering kali rentan terhadap variabilitas iklim dan peristiwa cuaca ekstrem.

Saat simposium berakhir, para peserta menyatakan komitmen mereka untuk melanjutkan kolaborasi dan berbagi pengetahuan untuk mengatasi tantangan yang dihadapi oleh sektor pertanian di negara-negara berkembang. Keberhasilan ISMAB 2024 tidak hanya menyoroti pencapaian Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM tetapi juga memperkuat pentingnya kerja sama internasional dalam memajukan produktivitas dan keberlanjutan pertanian.
